For part (2) the two points sit over a common point of the fibre product X'' = X' x_X X' by the cited Descent lemma; with Z the integral closed subscheme of the fibre whose generic point is x, each x'_i is a generic point of an irreducible component of the corresponding base change of Z, and the generic point of the irreducible component of the further base change containing x'' specializes to x'', forcing both projections to map to x'_i, while its transcendence degree equals r as a generic point of a base change of Z (source lines 808-827)
